module: Cisco Firepower Threat Defense Virtual (FTDv) Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 3 of the Security Policy
description: Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) solution offers the combination of the industry's most deployed stateful firewall with a comprehensive range of next-generation network security services, intrusion prevention system (IPS), content security and secure unified communications. All running in a virtual environment.
tested_configurations: FXOS version 2 on NFVIS 3 running on ENCS 5412 with Intel Xeon D-1528 (single-user mode)
FXOS version 2 on VMware ESXi 6.0 running on Cisco UCS C220 M5 with Intel Xeon Silver 4110
FXOS version 2 on VMware ESXi 6.5 running on Cisco UCS C220 M5 with Intel Xeon Silver 4110
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #1561, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 150 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #1561, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 256 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
